observations.content: Assistant delivered a Vietnamese diagnosis report confirming message_main delayed delivery is a REAL bug (not as-designed) with 3-layer root cause.

Root cause chain: message_main when parent busy pushes to pendingToMain and starts flushWhenIdle poll loop at paseo-channel.ts:182-215; flushWhenIdle polls get_agent_status every 5s (1s first tick) and only sends via send_agent_prompt when status is not running/initializing.
No pi lifecycle hook exists; comment at line 14 claiming 'agent_end observed over status polling' is a lie; implementation is purely blind polling with no agent_end/agent_settled/turn_end listener.

Self-inflicted deadlock: the authenticated POST poll itself keeps bumping the daemon activity/liveness window, so daemon keeps reporting parent as running, so poll keeps waiting; the poll is what makes session run forever (matching user's 'session chạy mãi không ngừng' symptom).

Timeline evidence: scout sent message_main 10:23:37 (parent busy, queued); parent genuinely idle 10:43-10:56 with NO flush (13 min); ~10:56 user manual STOP + chat forced daemon idle transition, next poll delivered via send_agent_prompt as a background turn.

Secondary theory: post-turn OM observer subprocess activity (observer started events at 10:43:16, 10:59:48) may keep parent agent 'running' in daemon status and prolong delay; delay appeared today only after OM installed.

Proposed minimal fix (not yet applied): 1) pi.on('agent_settled') in index.ts near existing listeners lines 343-360 calling new flushPending(endpoint) that atomically splices whole queue and send_agent_prompt once, using agent_settled NOT agent_end (agent_end can fire multiple times on retry/compaction); 2) clearTimeout(flushTimer) on settle; 3) bounded backstop poll max 2 times x 2s; 4) drain on pi.on('input') before processing new user prompt; 5) cleanup queue+timer on session_switch/shutdown; 6) fix false comment lines 13-15.

Assistant ended diagnosis asking user to confirm fix direction before implementing; noted it would implement with unit tests for flush paths, sync dev to live copies, and RPC smoke test per standard workflow.
User asked assistant to explain the proposed fix again because they did not understand the plan section.

Assistant wrote a 15-line Mermaid diagram comparing current bug (unbounded poll) vs proposed event-driven fix (agent_settled/input/backstop converging on flushPending), saved source to write_mermaid then rendered and published to viz/viz-message-main-bug-vs-fix-1788087820929.png at /home/coder/workspaces/learn/viz/.
Assistant spawned scout agent c3c263a0-de60-4410-bd68-be0e555fcb51 to vision-verify the bug-vs-fix diagram since the assistant model has no vision.

Scout reported VERIFIED: both subgraphs labeled correctly, HIỆN TẠI side shows poll to 'daemon vẫn báo running' to poll cycle plus 'user bấm STOP tay' to send_agent_prompt escape arrow, ĐỀ XUẤT side shows queue to wait diamond with all 3 signal arrows (agent_settled/input/poll 2 lần x 2s) converging on flushPending(); Vietnamese diacritics crisp, nothing clipped.

Assistant gave plain-language Vietnamese explanation using analogy of employee knocking on boss's door every 5s causing the 'BUSY' light to stay on; explained 6 fix items by hand and why no double-send due to atomic splice (3 people one house key: first opens, rest find door already open).

Assistant summarized before/after: before session runs forever needing manual STOP with infinitely delayed messages; after subagent message appears seconds after user's turn ends and session idles naturally; asked user to confirm the plan.
User asked whether the diagram can be displayed in the Paseo chat session ('Phần diagram có thể hiển thị lên chat session của paseo không?').

Assistant ran two greps to check Paseo timeline image capability before answering; extensions.md line 1418 documents pi.sendMessage for injecting custom messages into session which participate in LLM context, with appendEntry+registerEntryRenderer for durable TUI-only content; md-log.ts image grep returned no output.
